{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA rows
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Check remaining rows
print("Number of rows after filtering QA:", len(df_clean))

# Check channel distribution
print("Channels and their counts:", df_clean['channel'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum().round(2)
print("Total revenue by channel:", total_revenue_by_channel.to_dict())

# Find the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
print("Channel with highest revenue:", best_channel)

# Return the result
total_revenue_by_channel, best_channel"}
